newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee jumps with central bank help.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee jumps with central bank help.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee strengthened against the dollar and pound on Wednesday after central bank intervention in the interbank forex market, commercial banks forex dealers said.
The rupee surged against the dollar to a mean commercial rate of 20.1234 from 20.2240 on Tuesday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean of 32.3690 from Tuesday"s 32.6975.
Forex dealers said a combination of overnight dollar weakness abroad and central bank intervention in the local interbank forex market on Tuesday led to the surge of the rupee.
"The central bank sold (dollars) at 20.16 rupees to the dollar during the intervention, and this played its part in appreciating the rupee," one dealer said.
It was not yet known the amount of dollars the central bank sold during the intervention.
